exitCriteria: replace API runtime repositories with Prisma adapters for monitoring, feed, summary, delivery, identity and usage state
replace in-memory queue/outbox/idempotency runtime adapters with durable broker/outbox/inbox adapters
replace worker persistence, cursor, lease and scan reporter adapters with durable adapters sharing the same database/broker state
prove restart survival and cross-process scan status/feed/summary visibility through a targeted integration smoke

runtimeModules.risk: topics, source bindings, scan policies, scan jobs and queued scan commands are lost on restart and are not shared with workers
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Monitoring repositories can opt into Prisma with MONITORING_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining blockers are durable outbox/idempotency and broker-backed scan queue

runtimeModules.risk: feed items are process-local and not shared with ingestion workers
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: FeedRestModule can opt into Prisma read persistence with FEED_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining blocker is worker runtime wiring to shared Prisma source/cursor/feed projection state

runtimeModules.risk: summary jobs, artifacts, feedback and events are process-local and disappear on restart
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: SummaryRestModule can opt into Prisma job/artifact/feedback persistence with SUMMARY_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining blockers are durable summary event publisher/outbox and cross-worker summary execution wiring

runtimeModules.risk: delivery attempts, digests, realtime events, webhook endpoints, replay cursors and secrets are process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Prisma repositories, encrypted secret vault and durable replay cursor store

runtimeModules.risk: API keys disappear on restart and cannot be shared across API replicas
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Prisma API key repository with hashed key lookup

runtimeModules.risk: audit records, rate limits and quota reservations are process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Prisma usage records plus Redis/Postgres-backed rate limit and quota ledger adapters

runtimeModules.risk: scan dead-letter support view is process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: Prisma scan failure queue/read model backed by scan_jobs and failure events

runtimeModules.risk: worker scan attempts, source items, cursors, leases, failures and projected feed are process-local
runtimeModules.durableReplacementPlan: IngestionWorkerModule can opt into Prisma source item, cursor and feed projection persistence with INGESTION_WORKER_PERSISTENCE=prisma; remaining blockers are durable leases, attempts and shared scan failure queue

runtimeNoopAdapters.risk: default worker execution does not update durable scan job status across the monitoring boundary
runtimeNoopAdapters.durableReplacementPlan: use INGESTION_SCAN_REPORTER=monitoring with MONITORING_PERSISTENCE=prisma after shared queue/feed/cursor runtime gaps are resolved
